# https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo/methods/close

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo/methods/close

Closes the connection and releases the active transport.
Method Syntax

```python
client.close()
```

###  Arguments[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo/methods/close#arguments)
This method takes no arguments.
###  Example usage[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo/methods/close#example-usage)

```python
client.close()
```
